title: Seahawks sold to current NFL owner for record price. Who is Vinod Kohsla?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Seahawks sold to current NFL owner for record price. Who is Vinod Kohsla?
sources.description: The Seattle Seahawks will soon be owned by a venture capitalist who is currently a minority owner of the 49ers. The deal must be approved by NFL owners.
